decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The  materials, design and boundary treatment 
            for the proposed pair of semi detached houses would, by reason of their 
            position, appearance and use of inappropriate materials be out of 
            character with the house and street scene and would not serve to 
            preserve the character of the conservation area and is contrary to the 
            Policies  ENVB 1.1 (New Development),  ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Area) 
            and ENVN 2.7, (Trees and Community Woodlands) of the  Unitary     
            Development Plan, (2003).
description: Following approval for demolition of existing bungalow and erection of two 4 bedroom semi-detached dwellinghouses details submitted pursuant to Condition 5 (plan of materials, design and boundary treatment) of approved DOE decision dated 14/01/2004.
